Name: Mystery Box Crusher
Author: Poplinp
Description:
[size=3]Adds a [b][color=#b4a7d6]Mystery Box Crusher[/color][/b] to open your Mystery Boxes all by yourself! No Clint necessary. This is intended as an endgame, quality-of-life item.[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6]
[size=4][b]-- Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Opens both Mystery Boxes and Golden Mystery boxes in 60 in-game mins.
[*]3 different appearances to match your color aesthetic:  Qi Purple (default), Muted Purple, and Muted Aqua. see images for the different colors :) These are configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿.
[/list]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]-- Obtain in-game[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Available in Qi's walnut room for 10 Qi gems.
[*]You [u]cannot craft[/u] the Mystery Box Crusher, it can only be bought as the machine itself (think Deconstructor or Wood Chipper).
[/list]

[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Notes[/size][/color][/b]
The mod is comprised of the main Content Patcher mod and a small SMAPI mod for logic, this really shouldn't matter but if you see 2 mods in your SMAPI log (MysteryBoxCrusher and [CP] Mystery Box Crusher) that's why :)

I highly recommend combining this mod with Automate, since Mystery Boxes can drop more boxes themselves. Connecting the crusher to a chest (with Automate) handles that very nicely!
